start.text: The new defenses are in place. This attacker does not break in. It types its way in.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua! It sends pieces of text, a hole that was never closed, and a key to the master door.
A.name: Carla

B.text: An injection, a known hole and a stolen admin. That is three tricks.
B.name: Joshua

C.text: Each one is something we left open. Do not give it a way to join the pieces.
C.name: Carla

D1.text: [b][color=red]Injection[/color][/b]: pieces of a quote and of code. One alone is harmless, together they run. [b][color=red]Known hole[/color][/b]: it splits through a gap. [b][color=red]Stolen admin[/color][/b]: a new key to the master door.
D1.name: Carla

D2.text: That depends on the upgrades you equipped. Each trick has one defense that stops it. Without it, the trick comes back [b][color=red]harder[/color][/b].
D2.name: Carla

E.text: Use your cards to hit it, and [b][color=green]Exploit[/color][/b] the moment it is Exposed. When it attacks, you dodge, and you never hold a quote and code together.
E.name: Carla

F.text: Understood. I will touch one piece, not two.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: Everything I set up in Hardening is about to be tested.
G.name: Joshua
